rationale.conceptual: The method relies on widely used DFT techniques with no novel algorithms; it is a straightforward application of known approaches. Multiple standard calculations are combined, but each is conceptually simple.
rationale.execution: The pipeline spans 7+ distinct stages (geometry opt, phonon, AIMD, elastic, magnetic, HER, result aggregation), each requiring management of external tools (Quantum Espresso, PHONOPY), handling of many DFT runs, and careful assembly of outputs into a structured JSON. This involves non-trivial orchestration and multi-tool handoffs.

difficulty.reasoning: The underlying method is standard DFT with PBE-GGA, phonon calculations, AIMD, elastic constants, and adsorption energies; these are well-established in computational materials science. However, executing the full reproduction pipeline involves many interdependent stages (geometry optimization, phonon, AIMD, elastic, magnetic, HER) requiring careful orchestration, parameter setup, and result compilation.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Original DFT calculations used VASP with plane-wave basis; supercells up to 72 atoms require moderate memory (~4 GB) on CPUs. Input data (structures, pseudopotentials) is negligible.
